name: Matchmaking for Ghosts
source:
Tonight, Death is unusually generous. After forcing you to confront your life on camera, it offers you something rare – a second chance. But generosity has limits, and you’re warned not to squander what you’re given.

[From [url=https://phenomcloud.itch.io/matchmaking-for-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚，死神异常慷慨。在迫使你在镜头前面对生活之后，它为你提供了一些罕见的东西——第二次机会。但慷慨是有限度的，我们警告你不要浪费你所得到的。

[来自[url=https://phenomcloud.itch.io/matchmaking-for-ghosts]Itch.io[/url]]
